source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Build a valid food chain by arranging organisms in a simple sequence that shows who eats whom in one ecosystem.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Grass eaten by a hare and the hare eaten by a fox forms a valid grassland food chain.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Judge from the most visible feature in the figure, not from the mechanism's test.

intelligence.enrichment: A food chain is a simple linear sequence showing who eats whom in an ecosystem. Food relationships link the eaten organism to the organism that eats it, forming a chain of feeding dependence. The learner correctly applies this rule: A food chain is a simple linear sequence showing who eats whom in an ecosystem. A food chain is any list of organisms from the same picture or habitat.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Ecosystems and habitats. The student must decide: Build a valid food chain by arranging organisms in a simple sequence that shows who eats whom in one ecosystem. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names.
